info.title: MICROSERVICE-development-billing-dotnet-api-Create Api Subscription By Subscription Id-v1-spec
info.description: The Subscription Management API enables businesses to create and manage subscription details linked to specific subscription IDs. This API is designed for developers integrating billing functionalities into their applications, allowing for the seamless handling of subscription data. Typical consumers include fintech and SaaS platforms looking to automate their billing processes. The API facilitates operations related to subscription creation, ensuring users can efficiently manage customer billing cycles and payment schedules.
